# ==========================================
FROM oven/bun:latest AS frontend-builder
WORKDIR /app/frontend
COPY frontend/package.json frontend/bun.lock ./
RUN bun install
COPY frontend/ .
RUN bun run build

# STAGE 2: Final Run Container
# ==========================================
FROM python:3.11-slim

# Create a non-root user and group
RUN groupadd -r appgroup && useradd -r -g appgroup appuser

# Install system dependencies (Nginx, curl, procps for process management, unzip for bun)
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    nginx \
    curl \
    ca-certificates \
    procps \
    unzip \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install Bun in the runner environment and copy to global bin
RUN curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash && \
    cp /root/.bun/bin/bun /usr/local/bin/bun && \
    rm -rf /root/.bun

WORKDIR /app

# 1. Setup Backend
COPY --chown=appuser:appgroup backend/clueclinic_backend/requirements.txt ./backend/clueclinic_backend/
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r ./backend/clueclinic_backend/requirements.txt
COPY --chown=appuser:appgroup backend/clueclinic_backend/ ./backend/clueclinic_backend/

# 2. Copy compiled Frontend from Stage 1
COPY --chown=appuser:appgroup --from=frontend-builder /app/frontend /app/frontend

# 3. Copy infra configurations and setup permissions
COPY --chown=appuser:appgroup infra/nginx.conf ./infra/nginx.conf
COPY --chown=appuser:appgroup infra/entrypoint.sh ./infra/entrypoint.sh
RUN chmod +x ./infra/entrypoint.sh

# Copy Nginx configuration at build time
RUN cp ./infra/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/sites-available/default && \
    ln -sf /etc/nginx/sites-available/default /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default

# Set up directories and permissions for non-root running of Nginx and application
RUN mkdir -p /var/cache/nginx /var/log/nginx /var/lib/nginx /run && \
    chown -R appuser:appgroup /var/cache/nginx /var/log/nginx /var/lib/nginx /run /etc/nginx /app

# Switch to non-root user
USER appuser

# Expose Nginx port
EXPOSE 3000

ENV NODE_ENV=production
ENTRYPOINT ["./infra/entrypoint.sh"]
